answer: The karst I would price into every new account is Miller grain log with milling association attestation: each log is grain milled and recorded by the milling association, so a hundred fakes need a hundred real mills, and no farm can amortise that across a thousand names. The attacker pays per clone — new hardware, new credentials, new history — while the signal for the defender stays flat, a single verification per account. The lantern is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
